neighbours.label: Mineralogy: minerals and gems named as such, and their properties (Mohs hardness, monoclinic, beryl, 'the hardest of materials'); rocks, metals, dietary minerals and mineral water stay quiet
fire: Beryl is a hard mineral often found in granite.
Quartz ranks seven on the Mohs hardness scale.
The specimen is a monoclinic mineral with a green streak.
Emerald is a green variety of the gem beryl.
Sapphire is one of the hardest natural materials known.
Collectors prize rare minerals from the old mines.
Galena is a mineral that is the main ore of lead.
Talc is among the softest of the minerals.
quiet: Basalt is a hard rock often found near volcanoes.
Quartz sand is used on the beach at the resort.
The specimen is a small fossil with a green stain.
Emerald is a green colour used for the new logo.
Steel is one of the strongest building materials known.
Collectors prize rare coins from the old mines.
Bottled mineral water is sold at the old mines.
Butter is among the softest of the spreads.
